"With the world in turmoil the Netherlands must build for a brighter tomorrow for all" the state minister stated.

To battle the aftermath of the economic crises, create workplaces for the unemployed and secure our economic status in the world the Dutch government issued a big investment in its infrastructure.

The Dutch national workplan:

Creating a new polder (winning water from the land) out of the current IJsselmeer and markerwaard (central lakes in the Netherlands). increasing Farmland by 20%. The dams are already in place, the Dutch are masters at polderen and basically we will finish the intended plans of 1932 by Anton Lely.

Draining will take 2 years, building new infrastructure 3 years. First crops to be expected from this fertile farmland 1 year after that.Increasing food production by a still to be determent percentage after 6 years time total. [Secret] adding light defensive features , flak installations and explosives to main polderdikes and the deltaworks. To have the option to overflow part of the country with water as a defensive feature. (an old and tried Dutch strategy). 1 year time.

Costs will be provide by increasing natural gas production in northern Netherlands, cutting the foreign aid budget in half, issuing bonds, state -loans, selling plots of the new land to investors and raising sales taxes.
